goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann erklären, wie ein Restriktionsenzym DNA an seiner Erkennungssequenz spaltet, und daraus die entstehenden Fragmente in einem gegebenen DNA-Modell begründet ableiten.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can explain how a restriction enzyme cleaves DNA at its recognition sequence and use this to infer the resulting fragments in a supplied DNA model.

A.rationale: One sequence-dependent cleavage and fragment-inference competence; amplification and gel interpretation are separate atoms.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.titleDe: Passende Bedingungen für rekombinante Proteinexpression erklären
goalBinding.titleEn: Explain Compatible Conditions for Recombinant Protein Expression
goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an einem gegebenen Vektor-Wirt-Modell erklären, welche passenden Expressionssignale und Wirtsfunktionen zur Bildung des codierten Proteins nötig sind und weshalb die Anwesenheit der DNA allein diese Bildung nicht belegt.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can explain in a supplied vector-host model which compatible expression signals and host functions are needed to produce the encoded protein and why DNA presence alone does not establish that production.

A.rationale: One conditional explanation of recombinant expression; presence of DNA is contrasted with functioning signals and host processes.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.titleEn: Analyze Present Effects of Cultural Evolution
goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an einem gegebenen Beispiel analysieren, wie sozial weitergegebenes Wissen und erlernte Verfahren das Leben heutiger Menschen und ihre Umwelt verändern, und kulturelle Weitergabe von genetischer Vererbung unterscheiden.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can analyze in a supplied example how socially transmitted knowledge and learned practices change the lives of humans today and their environment, distinguishing cultural transmission from genetic inheritance.

A.rationale: One analysis of socially transmitted current practices and their human/environmental consequences. Contrasting cultural transmission with genetic inheritance bounds this analysis rather than adding a separate course.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.titleDe: Biologische Evolution des Menschen aus Fossilien rekonstruieren
goalBinding.titleEn: Reconstruct Biological Human Evolution from Fossils
goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus Merkmalen fossiler Funde begründete Hypothesen zur biologischen Evolution des modernen Menschen ableiten, um eine zeitliche Reihenfolge zu rekonstruieren und deren Aussagegrenzen zu erläutern.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can derive reasoned hypotheses about biological human evolution from fossil traits to reconstruct a chronology and explain its evidential limits.

A.rationale: One bounded biological reconstruction from fossils. The independent current-cultural-analysis performance now has its own atom 8023. The fossil P English residue is a material defect, not evidence that the current description remains combined.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann bei einer ausgewählten menschlichen Verhaltensweise Kenntnisse zur Abstammung des Menschen nutzen, um eine evolutionäre Funktionserklärung mit dem unmittelbaren Auslöser zu verknüpfen, und erläutern, warum eine plausible Funktionserklärung allein kein Nachweis einer konkreten Anpassung ist.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can use knowledge of human ancestry to connect an evolutionary functional explanation of a selected human behaviour with its immediate trigger, and explain why a plausible functional account alone does not prove a particular adaptation.

A.rationale: One bounded evolutionary explanation of selected behavior; proximal trigger and candidate historical function are complementary explanation levels.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.titleEn: Explain the Biotechnological Usability of Microorganisms
goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die biotechnologische Nutzbarkeit von Mikroorganismen erklären, indem sie Grundbauplan, Fortpflanzung und Stoffwechsel beschreibt.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the biotechnological usability of microorganisms by describing their basic structure, reproduction, and metabolism.

A.rationale: One integrated causal explanation of biotechnology usability. Basic organization, reproduction and metabolism are supporting facets explicitly coupled by the Bavarian primary operator; keyword splitting would lose that relationship.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Prinzip und Anwendungen der Polymerase-Kettenreaktion beschreiben.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the principle and applications of the polymerase chain reaction.

A.rationale: One PCR principle/application competence with controls and changed conditions; gel analysis remains separate.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann anhand eines Modells das Einbringen von Fremd-DNA mithilfe von Plasmiden oder Viren in Wirtszellen erläutern und Klonierungen erklären.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can use a model to explain the introduction of foreign DNA into host cells using plasmids or viruses and explain cloning.

A.rationale: One DNA-transfer and clonal-maintenance model. Plasmid and viral carriers are alternatives, and stable cloning is explained along the same workflow; protein expression is assessed separately in 374e.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann ein Beispiel biotechnologischer Medikamentenherstellung erläutern.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can explain an example of biotechnological drug production.

A.rationale: One explanatory production-chain example; multiple stages serve the single medicine-production performance. Exact V2 body is retained.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.

goalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Entwicklungsgenetik (Hox-Gene, Genregulation) für Evolutionsprozesse einordnen.
goalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can classify developmental genetics (Hox genes, gene regulation) for evolutionary processes.

A.rationale: One developmental-regulation explanation of evolutionary variation; Hox genes and regulatory timing/location supply a common causal model.

M.rationale: Assessed performance is explanation, model analysis and transfer. Required terms/data are supplied or taught through prerequisites; no new fixed recall corpus is needed to establish this goal. This judgment adds no deck or Verified Recall requirement.
